title: Which party will receive the largest share of the vote in Berlin's 2026 state election?
background: Berlin is both a city and a German federal state. Its state election determines the composition of its parliament.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Results published by Berlin's election authority or reliable contemporaneous reporting of those results.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the party receiving the highest statewide vote share in Berlin's 2026 state election. Subsequent coalition negotiations and the selection of the mayor do not affect resolution.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The party's name or its standard abbreviation.
last_rationale: Linke topped Berlin in 2025 federal vote; polls CDU 20-22 lead narrowing

title: Which club, if any, will win the La Liga Madrid derby on September 20, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official La Liga match result, corroborated by reliable news coverage.
  • Resolution: Resolve according to the final score, including stoppage time, of the Madrid derby scheduled for September 20, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Return the winning club's name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: The fixture list (Jun 30) puts the Sep 20 derby (matchday 7) at Atlético's Metropolitano. Atlético beat Real Madrid 5-2 there in Sep 2025. Real Madrid have the stronger squad under Mourinho, so this is close to even.

title: Who will win the women's 200m individual medley at the 2026 Asian Games?
background: The individual medley combines butterfly, backstroke, breaststroke and freestyle in a single race.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Asian Games swimming results, or contemporaneous reporting from Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the swimmer awarded the gold medal in the women's 200m individual medley at the 2026 Asian Games, based on the result announced following the final.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The swimmer's full name.

title: Who will be the first person charged in the United Kingdom over alleged involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide?
background: British authorities have been investigating allegations involving Rwandan genocide suspects living in the United Kingdom.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official public charging announcement from the United Kingdom’s Crown Prosecution Service.
  • Resolution: Identify the first individual formally charged in the United Kingdom in connection with alleged involvement in the 1994 Rwandan genocide, provided the charges are announced by December 31, 2026. Arrests without charges, extradition proceedings, and charges brought outside the United Kingdom do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The person’s full name as given in the charging announcement.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: A sixth suspect, a Rwandan man (now 71) arrested in Gateshead in Jan 2024, is still on bail and unnamed (Met, Feb 2026), so he could be the first charged; mass is left unassigned for him. Munyaneza was not interviewed after a stroke. The Mirror approached Mutabaruka and Bajinya (alias Brown) when reporting that files had gone to the CPS.

title: Which activist detained in Tunisia's Global Sumud Flotilla fundraising case will suspend his hunger strike between September 12 and September 27, 2026?
background: Four activists have been detained since March in a Tunisian investigation into alleged financial irregularities involving fundraising for the Global Sumud Flotilla, an international campaign seeking to deliver aid to Gaza. Hunger strikes are being used to protest their continued detention.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera identifying which of the four detained activists has suspended his hunger strike.
  • Resolution Conditions: The suspension must have occurred between September 12 and September 27, 2026, inclusive. Appeals to suspend the strike or statements of future intention do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The activist's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: No reports yet of a hunger strike by the four remaining detainees (only a Jun 19 Tunis rally for their release; the June Libya-convoy hunger strike was a different group). Renormalised over the four male detainees, tilted to Naouar, the most prominent, who has a hunger-strike history.

title: Who will win the women's 400m individual medley gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games?
background: The individual medley combines butterfly, backstroke, breaststroke and freestyle in a single swimming race.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Asian Games swimming results or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the women's 400m individual medley final.
  • Resolution: The question resolves when the gold medallist in this event at the 2026 Asian Games is officially declared.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The full name of the swimmer awarded the gold medal.

title: Who will win the women's 49kg weightlifting gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games?
background: Weightlifting competitors are ranked by their combined results in the snatch and clean and jerk.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Asian Games results, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the athlete awarded the gold medal in the women's 49kg weightlifting competition at the 2026 Asian Games.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The athlete's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Kyodo (Jun 22): North Korea submitted an Asian Games delegation list (~200 athletes, Sports Minister Kim Il Guk as head), so Ri Song Gum (2023 Asiad 49kg champion, 2025 world-record holder) is very likely to compete. Main risks are Japanese entry issues, injury or a top Chinese lifter.

title: Who will win the men's 200-metre breaststroke gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Asian Games swimming results or contemporaneous news reporting identifying the gold medalist in the men's 200-metre breaststroke at the 2026 Asian Games.
  • Resolution: Resolve when the final result of this event is publicly confirmed.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The gold medalist's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Japan Championships (Mar 21): 17-year-old Shin Ohashi won the 200m breaststroke in 2:06.59 (world junior record) ahead of Watanabe (2:08.57); both are on Japan's Asian Games team. China's trial winner Mai Shiting swam 2:09.33 and Qin skipped the 200 at the trials, so Ohashi is a clear favourite in the home-pool final (Sep 24).

title: Who will score the match-winning goal in Portugal's opening fixture of the 2026–27 UEFA Nations League?
background: Portugal enter the competition as defending champions. This question concerns their senior men's team's first league-phase match.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official match report or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera Sport.
  • Resolution: Resolve after Portugal's opening league-phase match in September 2026. The match-winning goal is the winning team's goal that brings its total to one more than the losing team's final total. The answer is the player officially credited with that goal, regardless of which team wins.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The goalscorer's full name. If the match ends in a draw, return “No winning scorer”.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: The opener is Portugal v Wales (Sep 24, Estadio da Luz). New coach Jorge Jesus (appointed Jul 10, deal to 2030) says he will keep picking Ronaldo, but Ronaldo (41) says the WC was his last and has not decided on his international future. Draw risk is ~20%.

title: Which country will become the 75th signatory of the Artemis Accords by September 27, 2026?
background: The Artemis Accords establish principles for international cooperation in civil space exploration.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official announcements from NASA or the U.S. Department of State, or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the country that becomes the 75th signatory of the Artemis Accords on or before September 27, 2026. A completed signing is required; an expression of interest or an intention to sign does not qualify. A signing after that deadline does not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: The count reached 70 with Serbia (69th, Jul 16) and Mauritius (70th, Jul 17), the 11th signing of 2026 (~1.7/month). #75 by Sep 27 needs 5 more in ~10 weeks (roughly 40-50% likely), and no upcoming signers have been announced, so the answer stays very diffuse.

title: Who will win the men's 100m gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Asian Games results or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the men's 100m champion.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the athlete awarded the gold medal when the men's 100m final concludes at the 2026 Asian Games.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The athlete's full name.

title: Which federal appeals court will next rule that state gambling laws apply to Kalshi’s event contracts?
background: Kalshi offers contracts tied to the outcomes of real-world events. Federal appeals courts have reached conflicting conclusions about whether these contracts are subject to state gambling laws.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Published federal appeals court decisions, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Identify the first federal circuit court of appeals to issue a ruling after August 31, 2026, holding that states may apply their gambling laws to Kalshi’s event contracts.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the federal appeals circuit.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: The 9th Cir. Nevada merits appeal (argued Apr 16) and the 4th Cir. Maryland appeal (argued May 7) were still undecided mid-July and may rule before Sep 1. The expedited 6th Cir. Ohio/Tennessee appeal is argued Jul 30 (its motions panel leaned to Ohio), and Kalshi appealed SDNY's Jul 7 pro-New York ruling to the 2nd Cir.

title: Which U.S. state will be the first to settle its lawsuit against TikTok over youth-safety claims?
background: TikTok faces lawsuits from U.S. states alleging that its platform harms young users and misleads consumers about its safety protections.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official announcements from state attorneys general, supported by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the U.S. state that reaches the first publicly announced settlement agreement with TikTok resolving a state lawsuit over youth safety and allegedly misleading safety claims. The agreement must be announced by September 30, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the U.S. state.

title: Which Indian cricketer will publicly say by September 20, 2026, that the 2027 men's ODI World Cup will be his last for India?
background: The men's ODI World Cup is the global championship for cricket's 50-over international format.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: A public statement or interview by the player, quoted by a reputable news organization.
  • Resolution Condition: Identify the Indian cricketer who publicly declares between September 1 and September 20, 2026, inclusive, that the 2027 men's ODI World Cup will be his final World Cup representing India. The question resolves when the declaration is made, not when the player subsequently retires.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The player's full name.
last_rationale: trim

title: Which national team will win the England–Spain UEFA Nations League match at Wembley on September 19, 2026?
background: The UEFA Nations League is a competition for European national teams.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official match result and contemporaneous reporting of the completed match.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the national team declared the winner at full time in the September 19, 2026 fixture. If the match finishes level, resolve as Draw.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's commonly used English name, or Draw.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Spain are the new world champions (beat Argentina 1-0 AET, Jul 19) and England finished third (beat France 6-4). England's Wembley home edge roughly offsets Spain's higher rating; the fixture is listed for Sat Sep 26.

title: Which city or region will the DOSB choose in 2026 to represent Germany in bidding for the 2036, 2040 or 2044 Summer Olympics?
background: The DOSB is Germany's national Olympic committee. Its domestic candidate selection is separate from the International Olympic Committee's eventual decision on which country will host the Games.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The DOSB's official selection announcement, as confirmed by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the city or region officially selected during 2026 to represent Germany in bidding for the 2036, 2040 or 2044 Summer Olympics. This concerns Germany's domestic candidate selection, not the eventual international host selection.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the selected city or region.

title: Who will win the Puyo Puyo Champions gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games?
background: Puyo Puyo Champions is a competitive puzzle video game included in the Asian Games esports programme.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Asian Games results or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the completed Puyo Puyo Champions final at the 2026 Asian Games.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the competitor awarded the gold medal once the final result is confirmed.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning competitor’s full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: JESU lists Japan's Puyo Puyo candidate 'Yuki' under his legal name Yuki Kurihara (born 2015, Tokyo Verdy esports). He won the GigaCrysta Grand Prix Final and the Mar 22 selection; the final is Sep 26 and Japanese players dominate the title.

title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One Azerbaijan Grand Prix?
background: The Azerbaijan Grand Prix is a Formula One race held on the Baku street circuit.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official FIA race classification for the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix, corroborated by contemporary race reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the driver classified as the race winner when the official race result is published.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning driver's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Antonelli won the Belgian GP on Jul 19, his 6th win in 10 races, and leads the title race. Mercedes have 8 wins, Ferrari 2 (Hamilton, Leclerc) and Verstappen has race pace. Baku's long straight suits Mercedes' straight-line speed.

title: Which country's representative office in Ramallah will have its diplomats stripped of their Israeli-issued diplomatic status in September 2026?
background: Foreign governments maintain representative offices to conduct diplomatic relations with the Palestinian Authority.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public announcements by Israel's Foreign Ministry, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the country whose diplomats at its representative office in Ramallah are formally announced to have had their Israeli-issued diplomatic status revoked during September 2026. The announcement of revocation is sufficient; implementation need not be independently verified.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: No new revocations beyond the precedents (Norway Aug 2024, Australia Aug 2025). Spain dropped because it runs a Jerusalem consulate, not a Ramallah office. Ireland and the Netherlands are moving national settlement-trade bans (Jul 13), likely triggers for retaliation before Israel's October election.

title: What will be the furthest round PV Sindhu reaches in individual badminton at the 2026 Asian Games?
background: PV Sindhu is an Indian badminton player and multiple Olympic medallist.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official 2026 Asian Games badminton results or reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Once Sindhu's participation in the individual badminton competition has concluded, identify the furthest tournament round she reached. Team competition results do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the tournament round.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Sindhu won the Japan Open (Super 750) on Jul 19, beating Akane Yamaguchi 21-17 21-17 for her first title in almost two years, after a SF and several QFs this season. Mass shifted toward SF/Final, but a likely QF against An Se-young or a top Chinese/Japanese seed caps her.

title: Which national team will win the first UEFA Nations League match between the Republic of Ireland and Israel in September 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official match result or reliable contemporaneous reporting of the first Nations League match between these teams in September 2026.
  • Resolution: Resolve when the match finishes, using the final score. If neither team wins, resolve to a draw.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning national team's name, or the result designation if the match is drawn.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: The FAI confirmed Israel's Sep 27 'home' game will be at a neutral venue, the Nagyerdei Stadion in Debrecen, Hungary. FAI delegates voted 75-32 on Jul 8 to fulfil the fixtures, so there's no forfeit risk and little home edge for Israel; neither side played at the WC.

title: Which U.S. state will ask a court to halt further development of ChatGPT over safety concerns in September 2026?
background: ChatGPT is OpenAI’s conversational AI service. State authorities can seek court orders restricting products they allege pose risks to consumers.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official state court filings or announcements by state authorities, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Qualifying Event: During September 2026, a U.S. state formally asks a court to stop OpenAI from further developing ChatGPT until safety safeguards are established. The request itself resolves the question; the court need not grant it.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the U.S. state making the request.
last_rationale: Sept request may be a new state; Florida suit Jun 1

title: Which national team will lead UEFA Nations League Group A1 after the matches on September 28, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official group standings or contemporaneous reporting from reputable sports news organizations.
  • Resolution: Identify the national team ranked first in UEFA Nations League Group A1 after all matches played on September 28, 2026, have concluded. Apply UEFA's official tiebreaking rules if teams are level on points.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country name of the first-placed national team.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: France (Zidane takes over Sep 1) play both matchday 1-2 games away, at Türkiye Sep 25 and Belgium Sep 28. Italy missed a third straight WC, Belgium reached the WC QF and Türkiye host both their games. A Poisson simulation gives France ~0.34-0.42.

title: Who will win the men's javelin throw gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games?
background: The Asian Games include separate men's and women's javelin throw competitions.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official Asian Games final results, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the athlete awarded the gold medal at the conclusion of the men's javelin throw final at the 2026 Asian Games.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The athlete's full name.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Pathirage (92.62 world lead, Rome Jun 4) is the CWG favourite. Arshad is fit, planned a Swiss DL start and defends his CWG title on Aug 1. India's Rohit Yadav threw 87.05 on Jun 28 (world No. 2), while Neeraj's SB is 85.69 after a back injury.

title: Who will Aston Martin announce as Lance Stroll's teammate for the 2027 Formula One season?
background: Aston Martin has not yet confirmed its complete race-driver lineup for the 2027 Formula One season.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Aston Martin's official announcement confirming its complete race-driver lineup for the 2027 Formula One season, corroborated by Formula One or reputable news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the driver named alongside Lance Stroll in the first such announcement published by December 31, 2026. A confirmed race-seat contract is sufficient; the driver need not have competed in a 2027 race. Reserve, test, and advisory roles do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The driver's full name.
last_rationale: change-signal trim

title: Who will Morocco's king appoint as prime minister following the country's 2026 parliamentary election?
background: Morocco's prime minister leads the government and is appointed by the king.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The Moroccan royal palace's public announcement, as documented in reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the first person appointed prime minister and tasked with forming a government following Morocco's 2026 parliamentary election.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The appointee's name or commonly used surname.
last_rationale: sweep Jul21: Hespress, Le360 and Maroc Hebdo (Jul 21) report that Budget Minister and FRMF president Fouzi Lekjaa will join PAM's political bureau and run in Berkane, to be announced at PAM's Jul 25 council; observers frame it as a bid for head of government. Analysts (Le Matin, Jul 13) still see RNI under Chaouki leading, with Istiqlal the main challenger; vote Sep 23.

title: Which country will end China's gold-medal bid in men's football at the 2026 Asian Games?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official 2026 Asian Games men's football results, corroborated by reliable match reporting.
  • Resolution: Identify the opposing national team in the match that eliminates China from contention for the men's football gold medal. Any subsequent bronze-medal match is excluded. If China wins gold, resolve to no country.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The opposing country's name, or “None” if China wins gold.
